exposure: non-recurring indications of previous cesarean section
Bishop's score at the time of admission
cohort: 100 women with previous cesarean section and 100 primigravidas
finding: Maternal pre-pregnancy BMI, non-recurring indications of previous cesarean section, good Bishop's score at the time of admission, spontaneous onset of labor, and neonatal birth weight were significantly related to high chances of success of vaginal birth after previous cesarean section.
mod_finding: This study found that neonatal birth weight was significantly related to higher chances of successful vaginal birth after cesarean section.
